Français

Montréal · since 2014 · Kimia Na MotemaNovember 2026

Defend the weak and the fatherless;

uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.

— Psalm 82:3

Kimia na motema is Lingala for “peace of the heart”. Since 2014, our Christian association has given food, clothing, school support and material help — free of charge — to orphans, widows, the poor and the homeless.

Christmas campaign Read the story

01

Chapter 01 — The need

Behind every door, someone is waiting.

  • A child growing up without parents.
  • A widow facing winter alone.
  • A student skipping a meal to pay for books.
  • A man sleeping outside on a January night.

We don’t publish faces in distress. We tell the moment things turn around — because everyone we meet is a person first, long before they are a need. Our ethical storytelling charter

02

Chapter 02 — The heart of the Lord

A heart turned toward the weakest.

By the grace of the Lord, the Provider and Rewarder of those who seek him, La Paix du Cœur exists to reveal to the nations the Heart of the Lord, turned toward the weakest: widows and widowers, orphans, the poor and the homeless, regardless of language, colour or race.

Religion that is pure and undefiled before our Elohim and Father is this: to visit orphans and widows in their affliction…

James 1:27

Where everything is missing, we bring first

Hope

Then bread, a coat, a notebook — and an outstretched hand.

03

Chapter 03 — What we do

Four ways to love, in practice.

Everything is given free of charge, in a spirit of love and service, for the glory of Elohim alone.

Founded in Montréal
2014
areas of aid
4
programmes
3
asked of the people we help
$0

  1. 01

    Food

    Food baskets, hot meals during street outreach, and supermarket food drives that fill pantries.

  2. 02

    Clothing

    Coats, boots and clean clothes, sorted by size and season, handed over with dignity.

  3. 03

    Schooling

    School supplies, books and study support for children, orphanages and students.

  4. 04

    Material or financial

    A one-off helping hand when a family goes through a trial: rent, an appliance, a starter kit.

Three programmes

  1. ISupport for people in needFood, clothing, financial and spiritual help for people going through difficult situations.
  2. IITraining workshopsWorkshops, seminars, talks and awareness campaigns, so that everyone can become self-reliant.
  3. IIIHelping other associationsSupporting the projects of other associations that carry social and humanitarian work.

Discover our missions

04

Chapter 04 — What you can do

Your turn to open your heart.

Your support through prayer, emails and encouragement is a blessing. You can also support the association financially, materially or by giving your time.

  • 01GiveA basket, a coat, a notebook: choose what you give this year.
  • 02Become an ambassadorYour birthday, your run or your church group can fundraise for us.
  • 03Share a verseMake a card in the site’s colours and help the mission travel.
  • 04Pray and get involvedCarry the mission in prayer, join an outreach night or a food drive.
